Done. The merge ran once and succeeded.

- **Artifact:** `out/T4/solution.py`, a plain torch plus safetensors script. It loads the sharded base via its index, verifies identical name sets and bit-exact equality of the 66 non-MLP tensors across all three checkpoints, then computes each of the 48 MLP merges against the untouched base with lambda 0.4 in float32.
- **Checks enforced:** name-set match, 114 base tensors, exactly 48 anchored-regex MLP matches, per-tensor shape and dtype match, non-MLP equality, merged count of 48, and 114 tensors both in memory and re-read from the written file. Each failure exits with an error before writing.
- **Output:** `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 114 tensors, plus `out/T4/REPORT.md` with the self-report. I chose a script over mergekit because mergekit does not perform the required three-way pre-verification and writes sharded directories rather than one file.
